solution:
Ta có f(5)=−10+m=limx→5−f(x).
Mà limx→5+f(x)=limx→5+2x2−7x−15x2−9x+20=limx→5+(x−5)(2x+3)(x−5)(x−4)=limx→5+2x+3x−4=13.
